name: buildish-mammoth-cache-gradle

scripts.clean: node -e "for (const path of [\"dist\",\"coverage\"]) { require(\"fs\").rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true }); }"
scripts.bundle:github: npm run bundle:github:main && npm run bundle:github:post
scripts.build: npm run compile && npm run bundle
scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.integration-test:distributed-reuse: npm run compile && esbuild scripts/integration-distributed-reuse.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=cjs --outfile=build/integration-distributed-reuse.cjs && node build/integration-distributed-reuse.cjs
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run format && npm run test && npm run rebuild && npm run release-legal:check-category-x

author: Apache Buildish
description: Apache Buildish Mammoth Cache Action for Gradle: secure wrapper provisioning plus local and distributed cache management.
